text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Loves Only You hasn't been in the best shape lately,
so we came to visit a shrine."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Dear gods, please!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...All righty!
Both of us wished for it, so it'll definitely be fine!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops, oh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Loves Only You's gaze,
I saw an empty can lying on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Just praying to the gods is too one-sided.
I've got to return the love back to them, too♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Loves Only You began
picking up empty cans and other trash.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Phew... Is it mostly clean now, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for picking up the trash.
Sorry for the trouble, but it really helps."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no.
You're very welcome.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You look familiar...
Wait, are you from that stream?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You know who I am?
Love Me♡ Love You♡
I'm Loves Only You♡

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text: I've seen it before! It popped up in my recommendations, and I've been curious about it ever since!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I run an online salon.
I do all sorts of live streams there too♪

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! In that case, let me in!
You must be Loves Only You, right?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Having a Shinto priest in the commu
feels like it'll bring us lots of blessings!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Loves Only You regained her positivity
and got her groove back!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I really wish they'd mind their manners.
Leaving food piled up like that, of all things—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Aah?! I went and cleaned everything up without thinking...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I have to put it back!
Dear gods, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Loves Only You grew even more disheartened, and her condition remained in a slump.
